booking_advance.question: How far in advance can I make a booking online?
booking_advance.answer: We accept bookings online that are <strong_p>at least 4 hours in advance</strong_p> (from Monday to Sunday). Do you need an urgent taxi or chauffeur service in Belgium within 3 hours? Call <strong_s>+32 2 520 75 26</strong_s> to check immediate availability.

airport_meeting.question: Where can I meet my driver at Brussels or Charleroi Airport?
airport_meeting.answer: Brussels Airport (BRU - Zaventem): Your driver will be waiting in the Arrivals Hall near the central Meeting Point (opposite the Java Coffee Bar) holding a sign with your name or company logo. For kerbside pickups, follow instructions to the Express Parking area. Brussels South Charleroi Airport (CRL): Your driver will meet you at the official Express Pick-up Zone outside Terminal 1 or Terminal 2. Your driver tracks your flight live and will send an SMS/WhatsApp message upon landing. If you cannot locate your driver, please call +32 2 520 75 26 or contact your driver directly.

cancellation.question: What is your cancellation policy?
cancellation.answer: Cancellations made more than 24 hours before the scheduled pickup time are 100% free of charge. Cancellations within 24 hours may incur a partial fee depending on the vehicle class. Please refer to our terms and conditions for complete details.

payment.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept all major payment methods in Belgium: Bancontact, Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay. You can also opt for secure corporate invoicing or cash payment to the driver upon request.

wait_time.question: How long will the driver wait for us at the Airport?
wait_time.answer: For all Belgian airport pickups (Brussels Airport Zaventem, Charleroi, Antwerp, Liège), we provide 60 minutes of complimentary waiting time starting from your flight's actual landing time to give you ample time for baggage collection and passport control.

vip_pickup.question: What is included in the VIP Meet & Greet service?
vip_pickup.answer: Our VIP Pickup service includes an executive Mercedes-Benz E-Class, S-Class, or V-Class vehicle, personalized meet-and-greet inside the arrival terminal with a nameboard, luggage assistance, and complimentary onboard Wi-Fi and bottled water.

luggage.question: How much luggage can I bring?
luggage.answer: Standard sedans accommodate up to 3 large suitcases. If you are traveling with extra luggage, sports equipment, or child seats, please select an Estate (Station Wagon) or Luxury Van (Minivan up to 8 passengers) during your booking.

no_journey.question: What should I do if the journey did not take place?
no_journey.answer: If you were unable to connect with your driver and the journey did not take place, please contact our 24/7 dispatch immediately or submit a refund request here with your booking reference.

no_phone.question: What if the driver does not answer the phone?
no_phone.answer: If you cannot reach your assigned driver upon arrival, call our central Belgian dispatch desk immediately at +32 2 520 75 26. Our operations team will locate your driver or dispatch an immediate backup vehicle.

no_meeting_point.question: I can't find my driver or meeting point
no_meeting_point.answer: Check your SMS and confirmation email for your driver's exact location. At Brussels Airport, look for your name sign near the Java Coffee meeting area. If still unable to locate them, contact our helpline.

cancel_booking.question: How do I cancel my booking?
cancel_booking.answer: You can cancel your booking online by logging into your account using your booking reference and email, or by contacting our customer service team.

change_booking.question: Can I modify my booking details?
change_booking.answer: Yes, you can change your pickup time, destination, passenger count, or flight number up to 12 hours before pickup via your confirmation link or by contacting our team.

view_booking.question: Where can I view my booking status?
view_booking.answer: You can view your real-time booking status, assigned driver details, vehicle model, and receipt by entering your booking reference in the 'My Booking' section on our website.

flight_delayed.question: What happens if my flight is delayed?
flight_delayed.answer: We monitor all incoming flights to Brussels (BRU), Charleroi (CRL), Antwerp (ANR), and Liège (LGG) in real time. Your driver will automatically adjust the pickup time according to your actual flight arrival, with no extra charge.

left_item.question: I left an item in the vehicle
left_item.answer: If you forgot personal belongings in the taxi, contact our dispatch team immediately at +32 2 520 75 26 with your booking reference and description of the item. We will coordinate quick return with your driver.

late_transfer.question: What if I am running late for a city pickup?
late_transfer.answer: For pickups at hotels, offices, or private addresses in Belgium, we include 15 minutes of complimentary waiting time. If you expect a delay, please contact your driver or dispatch team directly.

local_taxis_connected.question: Are local street taxis at Brussels Airport connected with your service?
local_taxis_connected.answer: No. Street taxis parked in the generic queue at Brussels or Charleroi airports operate on unregulated metered rates and are not part of our fixed-rate private network. Our service is pre-booked with fixed pricing and guaranteed driver assignment.

responsible_all_taxis.question: Is Airport Transfer responsible for public taxi stands at Belgian airports?
responsible_all_taxis.answer: No. We only operate pre-booked private transfers reserved via our official website. We are not responsible for public curbside taxis taken without a reservation.

cta.title: Can’t find what you’re looking for?
cta.description: If you can’t find an answer to your question in our Help Desk, our 24/7 Belgian support team is ready to assist you.
